title: Polish County Coats of Arms Grid Quiz and Geography Atlas
body:
- Added the 380 Polish County Coats of Arms Grid Quiz (/quiz-herbow) with voivodeship grouping, live stopwatch, instant client-side auto-accept typing, and Fullscreen Inspector.
- Added the interactive Polish Counties & Coats of Arms Atlas on /explore with voivodeship and county type filters.
- Added SVG normalization for legacy vector coats of arms missing xmlns and viewBox attributes.
- Added 12-card tile covering and progressive reveal to Flag Shades.
